long_description.body:
Throw your axe into this soft case and get to the gig! This Premium Gig Bag is made with a canvas exterior, 5 mm padded interior, 2 adjustable straps, and a handy outside compartment with a zipper that's perfect for a strap, picks, cable, etc. This gig bag will fit Kramer Striker, Pacer, SM-1, The 84, Baretta, Focus, Jersey Star, and NightSwan models.





Backpack straps for hands-free carry




Canvas exterior with zippered accessory compartment




5 mm padded interior and black cloth lining




Internal dimensions: 39.80” length, 11.20” upper body width, 13.00” lower body width, 2.56” depth.
